Definition: The versioned, schema-governed container owning persistence metadata for a persisted project; delegates model payload to schemas/model.schema.yaml.
Canonicalization scheme used for hashable JSON payloads; schema records hash.canonicalization = "JCS".
Parse, validate, normalize schema-approved details, serialize via JCS, reparse, and compare semantic equality of engineering-relevant data.

Synonyms: local SQLite project store;local storage profile
Definition: The MVP physical project package/container: a user-chosen, local SQLite-backed project store/index owned by the application-service persistence boundary.
Persistence metadata marking privacy classification, redistribution status, default transmission permission, quarantine requirements, and review status; default_transmission_allowed is false.
Envelope-recorded state separate from model content: current, migration_needed, migrated, unsupported_schema, failed, newer_than_supported, or TBD.
Schema record exposing the service contract; declares application-service boundary, minimum inputs/outputs, diagnostic classes, and bypass_prohibited = true.
The set of required validation gates: schema, model-schema delegation, unit, provenance, rule-pack, protected-content, private-data, professional-boundary checks, and telemetry off.
Rebuildable local projections such as SQLite FTS5/BM25 indexes and optional NumPy cache; must be hash-neutral.
External acceptance reference carried only as a hash-bound record with authority kind, binding hashes, and invalidates_on_hash_change = true; not certification or code-compliance.
Reference to non-JSON/binary or large files by path/URI plus hash, size, classification, and verification metadata; not silently copied into the package.
The data and authority constraints the persistence boundary prevents storage/sidecars/adapters/imports/exports from bypassing.
